subset.rationale: Abseil's value to the prove-out is the quantity of complex, fully-specialized concrete data structures that bind DIRECTLY (no fixture wrappers) — each named specialization is reflected head-on. This run binds two specializations of absl::InlinedVector (a small-buffer-optimized vector): <int,4> and <double,2>, to distinct Python types InlinedVectorInt4/InlinedVectorDouble2, with the full push_back/pop_back/at/operator[]/front/back/size/capacity/clear/empty/reserve/resize/erase/insert surface; differentially checked vs native Abseil (incl. the small-buffer spill -> heap capacity growth). It is the first NON-header-only corpus lib: the .cc-defined ThrowStdOutOfRange (from at()) is linked via the new extra_sources machinery. Two real binder-coverage findings were surfaced while scoping and are deferred: BINDER-0006 (absl::FixedArray internal zero-length-array storage member) and BINDER-0007 (absl::int128 free operator<< -> incomplete std::ostream caster).
skipped_features: absl::FixedArray (BINDER-0006: internal StorageElementWrapper zero-length int[0] member breaks def_rw)
absl::int128 (BINDER-0007: free operator<<(std::ostream&,...) makes the binder instantiate an incomplete std::ostream caster)
absl::flat_hash_map/flat_hash_set (deeper link surface: absl::hash/container_internal .cc units — next step after InlinedVector banks E)
